data.feature_policy: Use the same dataset features and fixed split as the main EHGNN-F experiment.

implementation_invariants.training_selection: Weighted sampling without replacement; deterministic hard top-k evaluation.
implementation_invariants.fixed_self_loops: Exactly one fixed implicit singleton self-loop per node for every method, excluded from the structural budget.
implementation_invariants.weight_api: Each variant returns one incidence weight per retained incidence to inc_weight.
implementation_invariants.reset: Every scorer parameter is reset between model seeds.
implementation_invariants.checkpoint: Validation-selected state_dict values are detached CPU clones.
implementation_invariants.test_access: Tuning writes train and validation metrics only. Test metrics are opened only after freezing one configuration per variant.
implementation_invariants.conditioned_memory_rewrite: Disabled. Evaluate the direct full-matrix implementation used in the paper.
implementation_invariants.initialization: Use mask_init_std=0.01 for final scorer projections or low-rank edge factors so initial scores remain near probability 0.5, matching EHGNN-F.

tuning.selection_metric: equal-dataset macro validation accuracy over all four datasets
forbidden_fields: difference from EHGNN-F or Random-Fixed on test nodes
tuning.feasibility_rule: Select only configurations with complete non-OOM tuning results across all four datasets; if none exists, report the variant as infeasible.

reused_controls.incidence: Reuse EHGNN-F, Random-Fixed, and Full records at 50% when all experiment settings match.

comparisons: Conditioned incidence variants versus free-logit EHGNN-F and Random-Fixed.
required_outputs: ten-seed means, sample standard deviations, and paired 95% confidence intervals
paired seed wins and Wilcoxon p-values with clearly defined correction families
effective forward density with fixed self-loops
peak allocated GPU memory for one representative evaluation seed per dataset-method

resource_policy.oom_policy: Record CUDA OOM for the evaluated implementation without substituting a different implementation.
